mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (historical median), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 4.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed tightening that compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0% (y/y), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE rise > 0.2pp and PAYEMS decline > 100k signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In triggered periods, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1400k units signals housing sector slowdown, reducing consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days during late-cycle economic conditions.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1400, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of policy conditions.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 is above 50th percentile, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE above 4.0% signals weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp and INDPRO decline > 0.5% signals monetary tightening coinciding with supply shock, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In triggered periods, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 100.0 signals industrial output contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days in supply-constrained economies.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.
